title: Quantum Entanglement Skill
description: A new active skill that allows a ball to temporarily entangle its state with an enemy ball. While entangled, a percentage of damage taken or stamina drained by either ball is shared with the other. If one ball dashes, the other gets a brief speed boost. This adds a high-risk, high-reward tactical element for squishy, high-damage balls to survive longer by tying themselves to tanks.
